cognates._schema_::_schemas_: Form 0 only. 'schema' is the Lithuanian nominative singular, spelled as the English — the bundle's own 'Schema' key already carries it. Forms 1 and 2 are 'schemos' and the genitive plural 'schemų', so only the singular coincides.
cognates._{count} schema_::_{count} schemas_: Form 0 only, for the same reason as the bare '_schema_::_schemas_' key: '{count} schema' matches the English because 'schema' is the Lithuanian nominative singular. Forms 1 and 2 carry 'schemos' and 'schemų'.
cognates.CSV: File-format initialism, identical in Lithuanian; every other finished locale keeps it as-is.
cognates.Deck: Proper name of the Nextcloud Deck app; product names are not translated.
cognates.DSAR: Initialism for Data Subject Access Request. Lithuanian practice has coined no equivalent acronym, and the expanded key 'Data-subject access request' is translated in full beside it.
cognates.Excel (.xlsx): Product name plus a file extension; both are invariant in Lithuanian.
cognates.ID: Initialism written identically in Lithuanian; the lowercase variant key 'Id' is normalised TO this form rather than left alone.
cognates.ID:: Same initialism with a colon. Lithuanian, unlike French, puts no space before a colon, so the punctuation is genuinely unchanged.
cognates.ID: {id}: Same initialism plus the placeholder; nothing in this string differs in Lithuanian.
cognates.OpenDocument (.ods): Product name plus a file extension; both are invariant in Lithuanian.
cognates.PDF: File-format initialism, identical in Lithuanian; every other finished locale keeps it as-is.
cognates.RBAC: Initialism for role-based access control, used untranslated in Lithuanian IT writing; the surrounding prose keys are translated in full.
cognates.Schema: Lithuanian 'schema' is the standard term and its nominative singular is spelled identically; core lt confirms it (4 hits), and the declined forms used elsewhere in this bundle are 'schemos', 'schemą', 'schemų'.
cognates.Schema:: Same word plus a colon. Lithuanian, unlike French, puts no space before a colon, so the punctuation is genuinely unchanged.
cognates.Ollama URL: Lithuanian keeps the attributive order for these, so a product name followed by URL is already correct: this bundle's own values are 'GitLab URL', 'Bazinis URL' and 'Duomenų bazės URL'. (Croatian differs — it fronts the initialism, so hr translates this key to 'URL Ollama'.)
cognates.URL: Initialism written identically in Lithuanian; the lowercase-variant key 'Url' is normalised TO this form, and the compounds are 'Bazinis URL' / 'Duomenų bazės URL'.
cognates.UUID:: Initialism with a colon. Lithuanian, unlike French, puts no space before a colon, so the punctuation is genuinely unchanged.
cognates.3: Numeric literal; identical in every locale.
cognates.30: Numeric literal; identical in every locale.
cognates.N/A: Abbreviation shown as-is; not translated in this UI.
cognates.ConfigSet: Apache SOLR product term; SOLR does not localise it and the admin UI names the same object.
cognates.ConfigSet:: Apache SOLR product term with its label colon; see ConfigSet.
